verdict.rationale: Gmail exposes a documented REST API for automated or programmatic message sending, read-only extraction and backup, and organization. It also offers server push notifications to backend applications and standard IMAP/SMTP access, so it can be driven headlessly without the UI. Community feedback adds that the Gmail API suits programmatic clients better than IMAP. Missing for 10: evidence of non-interactive auth suitable for CI (e.g., service accounts or headless OAuth flows), an official CLI or CI-specific guidance, and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI pipelines.
